Answer ID: 5600 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 750/637=B/1429) If anyone intentionally attributes a false hadith to the Prophet ( صلى الله عايه وسلم) he will be called a cheat and a liar, but for this he, according to Shariah , will not be called Kafir (infidel). As far as Ilm-Ghaib is concerned, if you have objections or doubts regarding it, you are requested to study Bawariqul Ghaib ( بوارق الغيب ) written by Maulana Manzoor Nomani Sb, Izalatur Raib ( ازالۃ الريب ) by Maulana Sarfraz Khan Safdar, and others books like Futuhat-e-Nomania ( فثوحاث نعمانيه ). Note : What do you mean by ?wrong Hadith?? And for what purpose has it been quoted? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
